className.description:
CSS Class Name which will be appended to the most outer element of a component.
Use this prop carefully, overwriting CSS rules might break the component.

selected.description: Defines if the component is selected. **Note:** Only one item must be selected per ui5-color-palette. If more than one item is defined as selected, the last one would be considered as the selected one. **Note:** Available since [v2.0.0](https://github.com/UI5/webcomponents/releases/tag/v2.0.0) of **@ui5/webcomponents**.

style.description:
Element style which will be appended to the most outer element of a component.
Use this prop carefully, some css properties might break the component.

value.description:
Defines the colour of the component.

**Note:** The value should be a valid CSS color.

waitForDefine.description:
Defines whether the component should wait for the underlying custom element of the web component to be defined. This can be useful, for example, for using instance methods when mounting the component.

__Note:__ This adds a rendering cycle to your component.
